inst1: In front of you on the screen, there will be 4 decks of cards: A, B, C, and D. When we begin the game, I want you to select one card at a time by clicking on a card from any deck you choose. Each time you select a card, the computer will tell you that you won some money. I don't know how much money you will win. You will find out as we go along. Every time you win, the green bar gets bigger. Every so often, when you click on a card, the computer will tell you that you won some money as usual, but then it will say that you lost some money as well. I don't know when you will lose or how much. You will find out as we go along. Every time you lose, the green bar gets smaller.
inst2: You are absolutely free to switch from one deck to the other at any time, and as often as you wish. The goal of the game is to win as much money as possible and avoid losing as much money as possible. You won't know when the game will end. Simply keep on playing until the computer stops. I am going to give you some credit, shown in the green bar, to start the game. The red bar is a reminder of how much money you borrowed to play the game.
inst3: The only hint I can give you, and the most important thing to note, is this: out of these four decks of cards, some are worse than others, and to win you should try to stay away from the bad decks. No matter how much you find yourself losing, you can still win the game if you avoid the worst decks. The computer does not change the order of the cards once the game begins, and does not make you lose money based on the last card you picked.
game_over: You've completed the task. Your net result is $
thank_you: Thank you for participating. Please wait for further instructions.
